query: What company traits explain regional clustering?

per_column.name: industry_ai_ml
per_column.rationale: Interpretable binary industry flag with reasonable balance (35/199); can be segmented against region to reveal clustering by industry.

per_column.name: industry_cybersecurity
per_column.rationale: Clear industry flag; somewhat rare (16) but still comparable across regions.

per_column.name: industry_cloud_infrastructure
per_column.rationale: Well-balanced (63/199) interpretable industry membership flag, good for segmentation.

per_column.name: industry_healthcare_biotech
per_column.rationale: Interpretable but very sparse (9 positives); limited comparative power across many regions.

per_column.name: industry_fintech_payments
per_column.rationale: Interpretable category but near-constant (4 positives); too rare for meaningful regional comparison.

per_column.name: industry_data_analytics
per_column.rationale: Balanced (43) interpretable industry flag, good for grouping.

per_column.name: industry_enterprise_software
per_column.rationale: Interpretable flag with adequate positives (21) for segmentation.

per_column.name: industry_semiconductors
per_column.rationale: Interpretable but very sparse (6); weak comparison basis.

per_column.name: industry_consumer_media
per_column.rationale: Interpretable industry flag with usable prevalence (25).

per_column.name: industry_venture_capital
per_column.rationale: Interpretable flag (17 positives); relevant trait to segment regions on.

per_column.name: geographic_region
per_column.rationale: This is a discretized version of the focus (regional clustering itself); it restates rather than provides an external explanatory trait.

per_column.name: region_industry_concentration
per_column.rationale: Values map one-to-one onto geographic_region counts; it is a proxy encoding of the region (focus), not an independent explanatory variable.

per_column.name: regional_industry_penetration
per_column.rationale: Opaque, fine-grained numeric score (many distinct fractional values) derived from region; not interpretable categories and effectively restates region-level aggregates.

judge.rationale: The distinct industry membership flags are genuine external, interpretable traits that can be segmented and cross-tabulated against regional clustering, which is exactly the exploratory relationship sought. However, the set is heavily contaminated: every column is duplicated (.1 suffix), adding no information; geographic_region and region_industry_concentration restate the focus itself; and regional_industry_penetration is an opaque, fine-grained region-derived score with no interpretable categories. Because roughly half the columns are restatements/duplicates/opaque and only the ~10 unique industry flags (a few too sparse to compare) truly enable interpretable segmentation, the set only partially realises the exploratory-analysis claim.
